sb_prompt: FIND OUT THE OTHER CALLER'S FAVORITE PRO BASEBALL TEAM AND WHERE IT'S HEADED THIS YEAR.  DO YOU AGREE WITH THE CALLER'S PREDICTION?
turns: Yeah, I was just thinking about the Cardinals last week. It's weird because my sister actually plays ball for their minor league team, so I know the pitching staff is struggling a bit more than the fans think. But hey, that kid on the bench? She could be a game-changer if she stays healthy. What's your team anyway? And do you think they'll make the playoffs this year?

Oh wow, your sister? That is actually pretty cool. I'm a mechanic, so I don't really know anyone in the system, but my cousin plays for the Reds in the minors and he's got that same look about him right now. As for the playoffs, I'm skeptical. They're looking good early on, but the bullpen is tanking and I think they might stumble badly before November. What do you think about the Cardinals' chances?

Yeah, I see your point about the bullpen, and honestly, that part of it does feel wrong for us. We got our main ace shut down in the second round of spring training, which is just... it's just a nightmare to fix that. But then, you know that kid on the bench I mentioned? My sister says she's got a nasty slider. If she can stay healthy, maybe she's the key we needed all along, and that could turn it around. What about your cousin? Is he feeling good, or does he have any injuries?

Yeah, he's feeling okay, no injuries so far, but I'm still worried 'cause the closer just got pulled from the rotation with a shoulder tweak. Honestly, even if he bounces back, I don't think it's enough to carry them; the whole staff looks a little thin behind him.
Yeah, I guess she's the only thing we've got left to bet on, even if I'm still pretty nervous about it.
That's just a long shot though. I mean, if she can actually stay healthy, sure, but if she gets hurt, we're looking at a really bad year. You know how these things go, right?
Yeah, I get that, but I'm still holding out hope because I actually saw her throw in the spring game and she looked electric.

Yeah, I saw the spring clips too, she looked electric, but you know what's scary? She's only twenty-two. My cousin's twenty-four and he's already saying her defense is shaky. It's a lot of pressure for one kid to carry the whole show.
Yeah, I guess it's scary to put that much on her shoulders, but you know, she's got more grit than most people half her age, and honestly? I think she's going to dig us out of this mess.

I'm not gonna lie, she's got fire, but if she gets whacked early or she crumbles, I'm done with the Reds. My cousin says the guys are already talking about trading her out for a veteran arm. Honestly, I think we'll just watch from the basement this year.
Yeah, I get that she's young, but she's played through some scrapes I wouldn't even put on a thirty-year-old. My sister tells me she's the only reason we're even close to being competitive right now.
She's got that same stubbornness my cousin used to have before he tore his hamstring in May, but I just can't shake the feeling she might blow her knee out by June.
I know, but she's already got the veteran pitching staff watching her back so maybe she won't break down yet.
Yeah, maybe, but if she's gonna be the star, she better not look like she's faking it in front of all those scouts, because then I'm totally rooting against her.
I'm not saying that's gonna happen, but she's already got the veteran pitching staff watching her back so maybe she won't break down yet.
Yeah, well, that's exactly why I'm worried—she's got all those eyes on her like she's playing for her life, and sometimes that pressure makes a kid shake instead of step up.

Yeah, I get that pressure, but she's the type of kid who'd rather play through the pain than sit on the bench and watch the team lose, so maybe she'll prove everyone wrong and show them she's got the guts to handle it.
She's got guts, I'll give her that, but playing through pain on a major league roster is risky, and if she fumbles one pitch, I'm not betting on it.
I mean, she's my sister so I'm biased, but she's already got the veteran pitching staff watching her back so maybe she won't break down yet.
Yeah, fair enough, you're her blood, but I just can't shake the feeling she's got too much on her plate to start today.

Yeah, you're right, I'm biased, but she's played through scrapes I wouldn't even put on a thirty-year-old, and if she can hang tough for one more month, maybe she'll force those scouts to take notice.

Yeah, but it's one thing for her to tough it out in the minors, it's another when the whole city's screaming at her every time she steps out there, so maybe she'll fold before the summer's even halfway through.
Yeah, I know it's a lot to take, but she's already handled everything the minors threw at her, so I figure if she can just last a few more weeks, she'll show them she belongs in the big leagues.
Yeah, I guess if she lasts that long, maybe she'll earn a spot, but I'm still pretty doubtful she'll survive the real heat.
Yeah, if she can just hang in there until the All-Star break, I'll believe she can pull this off, but until then, I'm just holding my breath.
Yeah, if she cracks before the break, I'm calling it a bust, but if she hits that mark, maybe we get lucky and see a real spark.
Yeah, if she makes it past that break, I'll stop worrying, but until then, I'm just sweating bullets.
If she makes it, good for her, but honestly, I'm still rooting for the Reds to find a more experienced pitcher to carry the load.
Yeah, if she makes it, good for her, but honestly, I'm still hoping the veteran guys will step up to share some of the load so she doesn't have to carry the whole world on her back alone.
Yeah, maybe, but if she can't get some real help, she's just gonna burn out before she even makes the roster.
Yeah, hopefully the vets step up, because if she burns out now, I don't think there's any way we make the playoffs.
Yeah, if she burns out before the vets even get warmed up, I'm definitely calling it a bust.
